description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, targeting Vampire Charmseeker
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Vampire Charmseeker
When Vampire Charmseeker enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cloudshift to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
